name: Unexpected
source:
After a sudden move, our protagonists, Ayumu and Nemu, find themselves living in the small town of Henyutamei. While at first glance it does seem like a plain old town near the ocean, that facade quickly disappears. They discover that there's a strange power at work, causing all the inhabitants to be extremely horny! Our protagonists are far from immune to these effects. In fact, the town seems to change them even more! Follow their stories as they meet new friends, visit cool places and uncover the secrets of this new town shrouded in mysteries!

[From itch.io]
translation:
经过一次突然的搬家，我们的主角Ayumu和Nemu发现自己住在Henyutamei小镇。虽然乍一看它确实像是一个靠近大海的普通老城区，但这种外观很快就消失了。他们发现有一种奇怪的力量在起作用，导致所有居民都变得非常饥渴！我们的主角远不能免受这些影响。事实上，这个小镇似乎对他们的改变更大！跟随他们的故事，他们结识新朋友，参观酷炫的地方，揭开这个笼罩在神秘之中的新城镇的秘密！

[来自itch.io]
